verdict.rationale: The pack documents a synchronous webhook for real-time authorization decisions and an API to submit and monitor disputes through resolution. It also claims "full transaction visibility," which hints that post-auth activity is programmatic, but nothing explicitly describes clearing, refund or reversal events arriving as webhooks. Missing for 10: webhook events for clearings/captures, refunds and reversals; stable transaction identifiers linking auth to settlement; dispute/chargeback webhook notifications; ledger reconciliation guidance; independent or hands-on corroboration.
